title: O for an Overcoming Faith
description: O for an Overcoming Faith in Tonic Solfa to ST. FLAVIAN, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book I, collected from the Scriptures, hymn 17, headed “Victory over death, 1 Cor. 15, 55 &c”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST. FLAVIAN; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O for an o-ver-com-ing faith To cheer my dy-ing hours, To tri-umph o'er the mon-ster Death, And all his fright-ful powers.

lines: To triumph o'er the monster Death,
Joyful with all the strength I have
If sin be pardon'd I'm secure,
The law gives sin its damning power,
Now to the God of victory
Who makes us conquerors while we die,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST. FLAVIAN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
